en: A doorknob is a wheel and axle that multiplies your twisting force to easily overcome the internal friction of the latch.
The sliding friction between ice skate blades and ice creates a microscopic layer of melted water that acts as a slippery lubricant.
Because Earth bulges at the equator, you actually weigh slightly less standing on the equator than standing at the North Pole.
Earth's geographic North Pole is actually a magnetic south pole, which is why the north end of a compass needle points there.
A single lightning bolt can heat the surrounding air to 30,000 degrees Celsius, making it five times hotter than the Sun's surface.
Sunlight takes exactly eight minutes and twenty seconds to travel the 150 million kilometers from the Sun's surface to Earth.
Sound waves travel nearly five times faster in water than in air because water molecules are packed much closer together.
Heat from the Sun reaches Earth strictly through radiation because the empty vacuum of space lacks matter for conduction or convection.
Roller coasters use gravity to convert the massive gravitational potential energy stored at the top of the first hill into thrilling kinetic energy.
A sharp axe acts as a moving wedge, concentrating your swinging force into a tiny area to split thick logs apart.
A parachute dramatically increases fluid friction, or air resistance, to slow a skydiver's fall to a safe terminal velocity.
Electromagnets inside maglev trains repel the metal track, lifting the train to completely eliminate wheel friction and allow massive speeds.
